selection.poolConstruction: Purposive 20-city expansion pool in four zero-published prefectures, outside existing 190-target manifest; GIS/open-data capability and municipal smoking inventory leads. Not population-ranked or exhaustive.
selection.algorithm: Exclude exact publisher names already in manifest; sort remaining pool by municipal code; take first 20.
selection.searchLimit: Two stored query strings per municipality plus focused follow-ups; search result ranking is not deterministic. Frozen URLs and selection can be replayed, future web content cannot be guaranteed identical.
